title: Baseline identity and production boundary
observation: The dirty working tree is preserved;57 linked objects,262 input hashes, exact ROM/toolchain archived.
impact: Build identity prevents comparison against stale HEAD/ROM.
recommendation: Use frozen inputs/outputs for review.
risk: Source or asset drift invalidates all comparisons.
validation: Recheck manifest and ROM SHA after every approved implementation.

title: Gameplay cadence is far below display refresh
observation: Static A about9 periods/update; authored M median776562T; DAP15/13/19 IRQ intervals.
impact: Measured update latency and missed display deadlines.
recommendation: Treat input/simulation/presentation rates separately.
risk: Harness is emulator execution, not physical button-to-photon.
validation: Repeat matched ROM on target hardware and audit temporal contract.

title: Changing-view software composition dominates
observation: Rotation B mean draw about3.36M T; near/mixed fixtures substantially higher.
impact: Millions of T states cannot fit59736T.
recommendation: Prioritize span/pixel/precomputation architecture and exact unroll candidate.
risk: Final VRAM equality does not prove identical scanout history.
validation: Replay exact tiles, alpha, occlusion, order, LOD and raster timing.

title: Unconditional DDA exceeds a display budget alone
observation: Static ray update485031T for28 rays; same rays recast on unchanged view.
impact: 8.12 display periods before drawing.
recommendation: Complete ray invalidation cache; measured exact hot-code alternatives.
risk: Door/switch/material changes must invalidate.
validation: Production-function ray outputs across poses/doors; no extra combat casts.

title: Short sampled input can be lost
observation: Physical UP pulse100000T long produces0 consumed masks/position changes over8 polls.
impact: Latest IRQ sample overwrites earlier states before slow gameplay poll.
recommendation: Resident edge accumulation plus deliberate held-state/time policy.
risk: Changing edge lifetime can alter repeat/pause/release semantics.
validation: All controls, fast taps, holds, simultaneous directions and pause carryover.

title: Large spatial control quantization
observation: 74/256 cell step; reachable yaw increments7.638..7.951 degrees.
impact: Coarse movement/turn jumps remain even after CPU improvement.
recommendation: Separate control tuning from exact engine optimization.
risk: Changing constants alters approved speed/collision/aim.
validation: Written timebase and physical control A/B; constants untouched here.

title: Simulation is tied to variable render cadence
observation: No elapsed time/catch-up; AI every4 completed updates, timers per update.
impact: View cost changes wall-clock player/enemy/weapon/switch timing.
recommendation: Specify stable simulation cadence and snapshot/presentation ownership.
risk: Faster exact code also speeds real-time gameplay.
validation: Validate both per-update state equivalence and wall-clock feel.

title: Live columns are not an atomic frame
observation: Composition/uploads occur after wait and span many IRQs; patterns updated in place.
impact: One VBlank alignment cannot guarantee coherent presentation.
recommendation: Bounded commit/buffering/pattern reuse research.
risk: Precise visible tearing/latency not captured.
validation: Scanline-stamped VRAM writes and original LCD/replacement-panel comparison.

title: Safe-copy bandwidth imposes a lower bound
observation: Linked copy3584 bytes101172T;14x256-byte calls102466T before caller setup.
impact: Full dirty viewport cannot fit one display period via current routine.
recommendation: Reduce bytes with exact tile/pattern reuse or redesign commit strategy.
risk: Unsafe transfer spacing is not approved.
validation: Actual VDP timing/access behavior and payload/address correctness.

title: Direction caching is already effective
observation: Basis cache skips56 direction products for translation/static states.
impact: Historical accepted optimization, no new saving.
recommendation: Retain; do not confuse it with whole-ray reuse.
risk: Incorrect basis invalidation changes rays.
validation: Existing ray-direction validator and all reachable basis replay.

title: Canonical signatures give limited scene-specific benefit
observation: +156 fixed bytes; about2.37% geometry gain, clean regression, no turn gain.
impact: Not a universal dirty-work solution.
recommendation: Defer or use only after broader workload evidence.
risk: Boundary/material/side invalidation and extra clean branches.
validation: Full native byte oracle plus multiple routes and boundary tests.

title: Constant plane writes improve pixel work
observation: +50 fixed/+142 Bank1; about13.62% turn and13.81% common J improvement.
impact: Largest implemented local whole-update improvement.
recommendation: Independent review before production integration.
risk: Compiler interaction, duplicated loops and alpha/pose boundaries.
validation: All palette masks/resolutions/HUD states and matched full-ROM routes.

title: Exact camera graph removes normalization cost
observation: 484 compiled edges identical;78628..85269T→462..465T micro; about1.95% turn-loop gain.
impact: Strong exact ROM-for-CPU trade, modest full-frame benefit.
recommendation: Optional after compositor priorities;2420 Bank2 bytes and1 RAM byte.
risk: Basis/index synchronization and slot2 ownership.
validation: Initialization/restart/reversals/load-state future APIs and combined layout.

title: This16-bit DDA is slower
observation: 11.79M host rays match; static ray cost+3301T, fixed ROM+203.
impact: Narrowing alone is not an optimization.
recommendation: Reject implementation; retain evidence/oracle.
risk: Cap bound is map-specific.
validation: Only revisit with favorable generated/executed evidence.

title: A single surviving projection is expensive
observation: Per-entity microcases roughly57k..63kT; rejected-behind17606T.
impact: One visible projection can consume about one display period before pixels.
recommendation: Measure narrower/factored exact transforms and reject ordering.
risk: Do not cancel across truncations or use renderer visibility for combat.
validation: Actual compiled transform outputs and rejection/budget/tie cases.

title: AI remains independent of visibility
observation: Every fourth update processes living actors, with LOS admission and collision.
impact: Correctness contract; measured contribution below dirty draw in these fixtures.
recommendation: Preserve while investigating renderer; no offscreen AI deletion.
risk: Worst crowded admission/probe costs need broader coverage.
validation: Eight active actors, offscreen pursuit, doors, hit/cooldown/attack phases.

title: Hot bank trampoline issue already removed
observation: Eight emitted cold sites; none per ray/pixel/normal entity.
impact: Broad bank reshuffle has no demonstrated responsiveness value.
recommendation: Keep hot invariants; add tables only with explicit access phases.
risk: Slot1 code/data lifetime and slot2 near-art/pause ownership.
validation: Linked addresses, declarations/definitions, nested cold calls, IRQ safety.

title: RAM can support bounded research caches
observation: 1239 persistent bytes;6937 gap to initial SP; sampled stack max410.
impact: Some additional working memory is plausible; no memory emergency.
recommendation: Budget caches by complete lifetimes and worst call chains.
risk: Observed SP is not exhaustive, bounds use unresolved-library allowances.
validation: Stack watermark across shooting/crush/restore/NMI and exact bank/RAM link.

title: Profiler build is not identical Release execution
observation: Counters enabled and selected modules use--opt-code-size.
impact: Profiled cycles cannot be blindly compared to uninstrumented Release.
recommendation: Use PC-boundary Release timing; counters only as perturbed work observations.
risk: Counter overhead and compiler allocation shifts.
validation: Freeze ROM hash/config and distinguish instrumented/code-generated counts.

title: Historical documentation contains superseded contracts
observation: Old speed/buttons/structs/corpse tiers/banks/60Hz assumptions differ from C.
impact: A redesign based on historical summaries would preserve wrong behavior.
recommendation: Use source and current evidence; retain historical reasons separately.
risk: Silent requirement resurrection or repeated already-landed optimization.
validation: Review current gameplay matrix and source-hash baseline.

title: Checksum validator scope is limited
observation: Makesms/validator sum first0x7FF0 bytes; full ROM SHA provides identity.
impact: Passing header checksum is not full-size BIOS validation.
recommendation: Independent reviewer decides future expanded-ROM checksum policy.
risk: No performance impact; do not conflate this with corruption.
validation: Header-size-aware policy and target mapper/cartridge tests.

title: Blocking pause freezes gameplay but restore is substantial
observation: Pause branch before simulation, restore then continue; idle has no world/pattern work.
impact: UI poll rate and restore cost differ from normal gameplay cadence.
recommendation: Retain semantics; measure transition/raster costs separately.
risk: Held controls, pending shots, shake and cached rays.
validation: Long freeze/state-byte tests plus actual restore display/timing.

title: Combat has intentional one-update latch latency
observation: HUD current edge, damage previous pending after current rays.
impact: Slow updates magnify a deliberate pipeline delay.
recommendation: Report separately; only change with approved temporal behavior.
risk: Weapon selection/pickup/pause between request and execution.
validation: One damage per fresh edge, no held autofire, current policies.

title: Validation is strong but not universal execution proof
observation: 23 validators pass; some use translated/extracted production, others models/regex.
impact: Passing models cannot approve arbitrary geometry/ABI/timebase changes.
recommendation: Expand actual compiled replay and tile/state oracles for selected design.
risk: Shared-model bugs and final-memory hashes missing raster effects.
validation: Independent mathematical boundaries, compiled path tests and hardware runs.

title: An exact height LUT is feasible
observation: 65536 domain cases,4097-byte table plus exact far branches.
impact: Removes a candidate hot divide without visual approximation.
recommendation: Research only until linked access/timing is measured.
risk: Bank2 conflicts/headroom; may be low value after renderer redesign.
validation: Compiled output/cycles/stack/bank cost, shared projection opportunity.

title: Production baseline remains preserved
observation: All262 input hashes match; clean final Release and all validators repeated.
impact: Experiments did not replace gameplay or leak profiling.
recommendation: Hand off evidence; do not implement/commit/push.
risk: Future changes require a new identity and approved specification.
validation: Final ROM hash,manifest,diff checks and full changed-file list.
